name: Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve
policyReason: Leashed pets may use the main use areas, Dunes Overlook and Mosca Pass trails and the Preserve, not the backcountry.
summary: Leashed pets may use the main use areas, Dunes Overlook and Mosca Pass trails and the Preserve, not the backcountry.

excerpts.quote: Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve is unique in that most popular outdoor areas allow pets as long as they are on a leash at all times.

dogRules.text: Allowed in the Preserve, Piñon Flats Campground, Dunes Overlook Trail and Medano Pass Primitive Road.
Not in the national park backcountry or wilderness.
Leash of 6 ft or less everywhere.
